== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Mournful Roar (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Mournful Roar (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): the earlier slip and this slip as cut from the sheets at 300 dpi, the second scaled to the size of the first; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
